# Repository Archived - Pull Requests Not Accepted

> [!WARNING]
> **This repository is no longer maintained and has been archived.**

MVOM has been internalized into our internal monorepo and is no longer accepting contributions.

- We are not reviewing or merging pull requests
- No further updates, bug fixes, or features will be added
- The repository is kept available for historical reference only

Thank you for your interest in MVOM. If you need to continue development, please consider forking this repository.
